messages:
Omar: Quick RFC — thinking about 'bucketization' for client-facing errors. Instead of exposing dozens of internal codes we surface 3 canonical buckets via headers (and the full code in body for those who want it): retryable, quota, and degrade. Also propose a short human hint header that SDKs can show. Thoughts?
Rachael: I like the principle. Reduces churn in client UX. We must tie each bucket to telemetry tags though so we can alert per-bucket. Otherwise debugging becomes impossible.
Frank: Slight pushback — many customers parse specific 4xx/5xx codes today to map to product dialogs. If we remove them from the primary surface, we need a strong migration path (SDK changes + console mapping).
Lia: For rollouts — can we do a tiered exposure? e.g., Dedicated gets full codes + bucket header; Hosted gets only bucket + hint. Makes support easier while we migrate.
Omar: Agreed on migration. Proposal: default headers: 
```
X-RW-Err-Bucket: retryable|quota|degrade
X-RW-Err-Hint: "try-after:30s" or "contact-sales" or "fallback-to-embedding"
X-RW-Err-Code: rw_1234_internal
```
Keep X-RW-Err-Code optional unless customer opts in.
Rachael: On telemetry: emit metric tags: error.bucket, error.raw_code, lease.tier. Also add a counter for bucket->successful-fallback to measure UX impact.
Frank: Console changes: add a filter for Error Bucket + a small column for Err-Hint. Also surface a 'client impact' estimate: percent requests that would have been user-visible if bucketization hadn't happened.
Lia: Rollout plan: start with internal SDKs + 3 pilot customers. Run canary for 1 week, then 25% traffic, monitor: latency, bucket rate, increase in support tickets.
rollout-bot: Canary flag now available: feature.err_bucketization = opt-in for internal and pilot customers.
deploy-bot: Rolling out header emitters behind config flag err_bucketization=true to canary pool (10% infra) — watch telemetry dashboards.
Omar: One more: error phrasing internationalization. X-RW-Err-Hint must be machine-readable codes only; free-text belongs in localized UI driven by SDK mapping. Avoid shipping free-text in headers.
Rachael: +1. Add schema to spec: hint is enum, optional detail in body JSON { "message": "...", "locale": "en-US" } only for tenants that enable verbose errors.
Frank: Minor: what about idempotency vs retryable? Some 409s are retryable with backoff. Bucket mapping must be explicit: add mapping table in repo.
Lia: I'll own the rollout doc & console mockups. Omar, can you draft mapping table for the first 30 codes?
Omar: On it. Will open a PR with mapping + dashboard panels (error.bucket timeseries, bucket -> fallback success).
Rachael: I'll wire the metric names into alerts: alert if retryable bucket spike > 2x baseline and fallback success < 60%.
Frank: Ok. Unless there are concerns, let's proceed with pilot. :thumbsup:
